title: A solvable normal form for coupled swarmalators
summary: Swarmalators are mobile generalizations of phase oscillators. Introduced to model systems in which sync and self-assembly interact, they remain poorly understood theoretically. Unlike the Kuramoto model for coupled oscillators, existing swarmalator models lack a normal-form foundation, and their basic stabilities and bifurcations remain largely unsolved. Here we address both problems.
